newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama says 18 ambassadors among Peru hostages.
newsitem.headline: Panama says 18 ambassadors among Peru hostages.

text.p: Panama said on Wednesday its ambassador to Peru was among at least 200 hostages, including 18 ambassadors, held by leftist guerrillas at the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima.

A presidential communique said ambassador Carlos Luis Linares' wife spoke to him by telephone early on Wednesday for about one minute, "confirming that he had not been harmed nor had any of the other hostages."

Rosa de Linares told the Panamanian presidency that according to her husband there were 18 ambassadors of various countries held hostage in a second-floor bedroom of the residence by rebels of the Cuban-inspired Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA).
They have threatened to kill hostages if the government of President Alberto Fujimori does not release jailed comrades.
